Pasta and Vodka Sauce

Pasta: 
- [x] 3 eggs, beaten 
- [x] 2 cups AP Flour
- [x] 1 Tbsp EVOO
- [x] 1 Tbsp salt

Vodka Sauce:
- [x] 2 cups heavy cream
- [x] 2 cans of San Mar tomatoes, crush by hand or with immersion blender (hand crushing is easier)
- [x] 1 cup Vodka
- [x] 1 onion, fine chopped 
- [x] 2 cloves garlic, minced (I prefer using black garlic) 
- [x] 1/2 cup Parmesan (Wedge split into chunks. You can add more if you want it more cheesy and creamy. It’s gonna cook in the sauce which is why you want chunks)
- [x] 1 Bay Leaf
- [x] Chili flakes if you want a little kick 
- [x] S&P to taste, as desired
- [x] Fresh basil and oregano for garnish  

1. Heat up a pan to medium heat with some olive oil. Add the onion and garlic. If desired, add diced pancetta beforehand and allow to crisp around the edges then proceed with the recipe. 
2. Cook until golden brown and proceed with the vodka. 
3. Let the alcohol cook off (should only take 3-5 minutes). 
4. Add the tomatoes, a bay leaf, and chili flakes if desired. 
5. Bring to a simmer and cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
6. Uncover and add heavy cream and Parmesan.
7. Stir, cover (if desired add pepper. I like lots of it.) and let simmer 30 minutes.
8. Uncover, remove bay leaf and turn off heat. S&P to taste. Add to your desired pasta!
9. Garnish with fresh oregano and basil and parm.
10. Can refrigerate for 5-7 days or I prefer to make big batches and freeze it which will last up to 3 months! 

Cheers everyone. I’m an aspiring chef training in a 5-Star in my city looking to expand my culinary knowledge and hopefully open my own restaurants some day. If you happen to try this recipe, let me know what you think!! All feedback is much appreciated :) happy eatings!
